name: MCPJam Backend E2B sandbox running >3h (leak)
description: PAGE — owner: marcelo. At least one E2B sandbox has been running for more than 3 hours, on two consecutive checks.

TRIAGE: `e2b sandbox list` (or GET /v2/sandboxes?state=running with the prod key) → startedAt, templateID, metadata. Match the template alias to the creator (desktop = inspector browserd; harness/eval = Convex e2b provider) and check the matching reaper cron in convex/crons.ts is still running (function_execution path).
Source: e2b_fleet_snapshot (mcpjam-backend convex/e2bFleet.ts, every 5 min from E2B GET /v2/sandboxes). Silent until backend PR #1398 is in PROD.
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: leaks, not fan-out, are how E2B spends money silently — a box that outlives its run keeps billing per second until E2B's autoPause or our reapers catch it. Harness boxes, eval sandboxes and desktop browsers all have sub-3h intended lifetimes (idle sweeps run every 1-15 min). One box over 3h is already a bug worth a message.

SOURCE: `e2b_fleet_snapshot`, emitted every 5 min by mcpjam-backend `convex/e2bFleet.ts` (cron 'snapshot e2b fleet') straight from E2B's GET /v2/sandboxes under the shared team key. It is the only view that includes harness boxes, eval sandboxes AND the inspector's desktop browser sessions; `computer_concurrency_snapshot` (projectComputers rows) misses all three. Until that backend PR is in PROD this query returns no rows and the monitor stays silent.

WHY THRESHOLDS ARE PROVISIONAL: no baseline exists yet (fleet was 0 running when this was written). Re-measure after a week: | summarize max(estUsdPerHour), percentile(estUsdPerHour,95) by bin(_time,1d).
ROLLBACK: node ops/axiom-monitors/apply.mjs --delete e2b-sandbox-age --apply, or revert the file and re-apply.
